blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (BOC-Naia) seized 307.866 kilograms of high-grade marijuana, or kush, worth an estimated ₱369.44 million in two shipments from Thailand on Monday, Nov. 23. The shipments were bound for consignees in Bulacan and Caloocan City. Customs personnel flagged both shipments based on information from Thailand Customs and cargo profiling. X-ray screening revealed suspicious images, and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) conducted a K9 inspection of the shipments.
